title: ClockSync
description: Anchor between the device monotonic clock and UTC, published by the gateway on .../device/{device_id}/clock at session start and then periodically (suggested every 60 s). The ESP32 has no real-time clock, so t0_device_ms of every chunk is mapped to UTC with the latest anchor of the same boot_id. Drift between anchors is the clock error.

device_ms.description: Device monotonic clock reading (ms since boot) at the anchor.

utc.description: UTC instant that corresponds to device_ms.

uncertainty_ms.description: Estimated error of the anchor (half round-trip time of the exchange). BLE links are usually tens of ms.
